messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend public holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Provinces/Regions where it creates a long weekend |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island) | Monday | Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, PEI |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | All provinces & territories (public holiday) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | All provinces & territories (public holiday) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | All provinces & territories (public holiday) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | All provinces & territories (public holiday) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | All provinces & territories (public holiday) |

### Notes & Variations

| Province/Region | Extra long‑weekend holidays in 2023 |
|-----------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | **Mar 17** – St. Patrick’s Day (Friday) |
| **British Columbia** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) |
| **Quebec** | **Jun 24** – Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day (Monday) |
| **Nova Scotia** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |
| **Manitoba** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |
| **Ontario** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |
| **Alberta** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |
| **Saskatchewan** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |
| **New Brunswick** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |
| **Prince Edward Island** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |
| **Northwest Territories** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |
| **Yukon** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |
| **Nunavut** | **Jun 12** – BC Day (Monday) (observed as a provincial holiday) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - Use the federal holidays that create long weekends (the table above).  
> - Add province‑specific holidays if you want to support users in those regions.  
> - Remember that some holidays (e.g., Good Friday, Victoria Day) are federal and apply nationwide, while others (e.g., Family Day, BC Day) are provincial.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of all public holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends) or a breakdown by each province!
